The K20i semi-in-ear earbuds from soundcore deliver crystal-clear audio with up to 36 hours of total playback.
13mm dynamic drivers, a torus acoustic design and BassUp technology give music, podcasts and games a rich, full sound.
Each earbud weighs only 3.3g and sits securely in the ear without ear tips, so you can wear them all day.
Dual-mic AI noise reduction separates your voice from background noise, and touch controls handle calls and playback.
Choose from 22 EQ presets or build your own settings in the app to match the way you like to listen.
A dedicated Game Mode sharpens audio clarity and spatial awareness while you play.
